items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Well, my first band was named, we had a fella by the name of Thomas Copeland, Maurice Duran.

ctx.x: What was your very first band then, after you started out?
Well, my first band was named, we had a fella by the name of Thomas Copeland, Maurice Duran.
What did Copeland play? I knew him.
